subject: Fasting glucose slightly high
body: Hi, I did my fasting glucose test this morning and the result was 106 mg/dL. The lab slip says the normal upper limit is 100 mg/dL. I feel fine — no dizziness, no symptoms. Just wanted to check if I need to do anything.

subject: Blood pressure and heart rate readings
body: Took my BP at home with my cuff: 185/112. Heart rate was 110. No other complaints to report.
